It is designed to easily mount on the wall. A hook and hang design allows hassle free installation. This all‑weather outdoor TV wall mount supports up to 100" flat panel screens with adjustments that always give you the optimal viewing angle. Tamperproof installation hardware reduces the risk of theft and vandalism. Pair with a padlock (not included) for additional security.   *The minimum and maximum display sizes are only approximations.
